- Integrations: will use SSE or WebSocket streaming in frontend; asked about SDK examples and sample streaming front-end repo.

Customer mindset: very pragmatic — wants quick POC with measurable latency numbers and simple billing. Not ready for dedicated or private. Prefers hosted API self-serve then move to Dedicated when >$5k mrr.
